Assignment                                              Points         Online
Discussions (4 @ 20 points each)                         80            20%

Summary of Assignments
Writing Assignments
Writing assignments must be APA-compliant and include a title page, appropriate citations, and references. The
professor will post Unit Assignments on the first day of each unit. Assignments are due no later than 11:59 p.m.
(CT) on Saturday. Earlier submissions are encouraged.

Discussion Questions
Threaded Discussion Format:
Submit an initial post(s) responding to the prompt before 11:59 p.m. on Wednesday. Initial posts should be
within a range of 250-500 words. Post your reflections on at least two other posts before 11:59 p.m. on
Saturday of that same week. Both the post and reply must contain references.

UNIT ONE: Foundations
Unit Activities
  •   Read assigned materials.

Reading Assignments
  •   Text: Leading Through Change; Chapters 1, 2.
  •   Article: A working definition of leadership.

Discussion Questions: Post your initial responses to the discussion forum by Wednesday 11:59 p.m.
   •   Discussion Question 1
          o Prompt: Describe a leader you have observed and explain which leadership definition
              from the reading fits that person best.
          o Requirements: Type: Threaded format
   •   Discussion Question 2
          o Prompt: Is leadership learned or inherited? Support your view with the reading.
          o Requirements:Type: Threaded format

Writing Assignments: Submit by Saturday 11:59 p.m.
  •   NO WRITTEN ASSIGNMENT: Focus on the project.

UNIT TWO: Change and Power
Reading Assignments
  •   Article: Power and teams

Discussion Question: Post your initial response by Wednesday 11:59 p.m.
   •   Discussion Question
       o Prompt: When should a manager use power and when should a manager use influence tactics?
       o Requirements: Type: Threaded format

Writing Assignments: Submit by Saturday 11:59 p.m.
  • Project 1: Change at a Small Firm
         o Prompt: In APA 7 format, present a 1500-2000-word document (not including title page,
             abstract, or references) describing a change effort at a small firm and the leadership
             strategies used.
         o Requirements: APA7 format, 1500-2000 words (not including title page, abstract, or references)

Reminder: Major Project is due next week.
